references.text: This verse refers to the Holy Spirit who had not yet been given because Jesus had not yet been glorified, which underscores the significance and holy nature of the Holy Spirit, related to the warning against blaspheming the Holy Spirit in Matthew 12:32.
The warning against falling away after receiving knowledge of the truth and the Holy Spirit, reflecting the seriousness of blaspheming the Holy Spirit as mentioned in Matthew 12:32.

This verse speaks of a stricter punishment for those who have trampled the Son of God underfoot, treated the blood of the covenant as unholy, and insulted the Spirit of grace, which corresponds with the gravity of blaspheming the Holy Spirit in Matthew 12:32.
